description: This file defines the Role class for the SuiteCRM system, which manages roles, permissions, and relationships with modules and users within the CRM. It contains class properties, methods for querying and setting relationships, and logic for handling role-based access control.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Represents a user role within SuiteCRM, managing role details, module permissions, and user associations.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the name of the role for summary display.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Creates and returns a query for exporting role data, delegating to another query method.

methods.name: query_modules
methods.description: Retrieves module IDs associated with the role, filtered by allow permission.

methods.name: set_module_relationship
methods.description: Establishes module relationships for a given role with specified allow permissions.

methods.name: clear_module_relationship
methods.description: Removes all module relationships for a given role.

methods.name: clear_user_relationship
methods.description: Removes a user's association with a role.

methods.name: query_user_allowed_modules
methods.description: Retrieves modules allowed for a user based on their roles.

methods.name: query_user_disallowed_modules
methods.description: Returns modules disallowed for a user by comparing against allowed modules.

methods.name: get_users
methods.description: Fetches those users who are associated with this role.

methods.name: check_user_role_count
methods.description: Returns the number of roles assigned to a specific user.
